sources.title: Statistics Botswana, Population and Housing Census 2022 — Administrative and Technical Report, Version 2
sources.role: official census operations and roster nomenclature; not statute/boundary certification
sources.vintage: 2022 PHC; report version 2 published 2025-07-28; server Last-Modified 2025-08-27
sources.license: Statistics Botswana terms permit reuse of statistical data with acknowledgement; the report publication remains copyrighted.
sources.restoration: GET the exact URL, save response body without transformation, verify 1,753,665 bytes and SHA-256 above; if changed, preserve as a new dated vintage. Cite Statistics Botswana.
sources.findings: Section 14.6/Table 4 (report p.36) names 28 census districts and separate Sub-District/Admin Authority descriptions. Table 4 differentiates City/Town, district, census district and next-tier authority names. It does not establish all current legal polygons.

sources.title: Statistics Botswana Terms of Use
sources.license: Statistical data free to reuse with source acknowledgement; publication copyright retained.
sources.restoration: Open official terms page and confirm the then-current statistical data/publication clauses before redistribution.

sources.title: Government of Botswana, Maps and Geospatial Data
sources.role: authoritative access path for survey and mapping data layers
sources.license: Access/reuse license for a requested layer not established; page indicates request/fee route through Department of Surveys and Mapping.
sources.restoration: Request dated BWA district/subdistrict boundary layer, metadata, source vintage, coordinate reference, completeness, legal basis and written redistribution/adaptation license from Department of Surveys and Mapping; archive response and exact bytes/hashes.

sources.title: Esri / Michael Bauer Research Botswana Subdistrict Boundaries item
sources.role: public item metadata for a current commercial/reference product; not downloadable evidence
sources.license: Esri Master License; metadata says offline export is not permitted and access requires subscription/registered developer account.
sources.restoration: Use public item metadata only. Do not export, scrape, or redistribute the boundary layer. Seek vendor permission or an independent open official source.

sources.title: Retained geoBoundaries/RCMRD BWA ADM2 source as supplied in ancestor packet
sources.role: original geometry evidence, source-reported by geoBoundaries as RCMRD 2015; all 25 features retained for reproducibility
sources.license: source metadata reports Public Domain. RCMRD portal terms allow access/copy/use with license assessment; original metadata and provenance must travel with geometry.
sources.retention: lawful source bytes copied unchanged from prior committed evidence
sources.restoration: Compare exact bytes to this checksum and inspect companion original geoBoundaries metadata and the source-specific RCMRD license provenance before redistribution. Treat 2015 as historical vintage.

sources.title: Government of Lesotho, Third National Communication, Chapter 2
sources.role: official national context and administrative/council tier counts; figure 2.3 map attribution to Lesotho Meteorological Services
sources.license: publication copyright/reuse not stated in captured page
sources.restoration: Official URL declared 26,096,689 bytes; earlier bounded HTTPS transfer timed out at 3,538,464 bytes; local TLS chain validation failed. Retry standard verified HTTPS or request official copy/clearance, never disable certificate checks. Record complete byte count/hash before any full-text redistribution.
sources.finding: Reports ten administrative districts, 80 constituencies and 124 community councils; useful tiers/counts but not district polygon law.

sources.title: Government of Lesotho Gazette Extraordinary, Legal Notice No. 37 of 2022 — Constituency Delimitation Order
sources.role: official legal source for 80 electoral constituencies and map-sheet precedence
sources.vintage: 2022 order based on census available in 2018
sources.license: no redistribution license identified in the instrument
sources.restoration: Retrieve exact official PDF, verify bytes and hash. Order states district aggregation is for election convenience; deposited individual constituency maps and schedule prevail in conflict. These are electoral boundaries, not substitutes for district/admin maps.

sources.title: Independent Electoral Commission Lesotho constituency maps
sources.role: official election constituency maps; not community council/district boundary source
sources.restoration: Retain map links, download dates, file sizes and exact checksums only after verifying terms. Electoral function cannot prove district-tier geometry.

sources.title: UN SALB Lesotho administrative level 1 validated data metadata
sources.role: nationally validated district-layer source metadata; SALB methodology says contributor supplied and nationally validated
sources.vintage: temporal validity 1990 onward; dataset last updated 2024-06-24
sources.license: UN SALB Terms of Use 2021: noncommercial use, UN and contributor attribution; no geometry/content changes without contributor consent; no warranty. Contributor permission not documented.
sources.restoration: Request current contributor data and explicit reuse/adaptation permission from Lesotho National Geospatial Information Authority / Department of Lands, Surveys and Physical Planning and SALB; retain source version and exact bytes after authorization.

sources.title: UN SALB Terms of Use (2021)
sources.license: noncommercial; attribution required; geometry/content modification requires contributor consent
sources.restoration: Re-read live terms and obtain contributor consent before adapting/redistributing geometry.

sources.title: Retained geoBoundaries/OSM LSO ADM1 input from prior packet
sources.role: original 2017 district polygon input; OSM-derived, secondary to official/national source
sources.license: ODbL 1.0 as declared by source metadata; attribution/share-alike obligations apply to database use.
sources.retention: lawful source bytes copied unchanged from prior committed evidence
sources.restoration: Verify bytes, inspect original geoBoundaries metadata and comply with ODbL if database use is made. Never elevate the 2017 OSM-derived boundaries to current statutory authority by name matching.

sources.title: Department of Rural Water Supply ArcGIS Lesotho Boundaries MapServer
sources.role: potential district/community-council boundary service; access blocked
sources.license: unknown; metadata attribution and license fields were unavailable
sources.restoration: Request authenticated service metadata/access from Department of Rural Water Supply, source vintage and attribution/license; the captured response is HTTP 200 with ArcGIS application error 499 Token Required, not service metadata.
